head.title: International Management & Information Systems-online (career-integrated continuing combined degree course)
head.subline: part time degree programmes for professionals, distance studies, international course, part time

data.headline: Focus
data.text: Business Informatics, Information Systems, ERP Enterprise Resource Planning, Business Intelligence, E-Business, Management Accounting & Finance, International Management, International Economics, Process Management, Innovation Management

data.headline: Target group
data.text: The aim of the part-time IMIS Online (MA) is a modern, management and IT-oriented qualification of future management staff. The course is aimed at aspiring employees who want to further develop their management skills and add knowledge and skills related to modern information and communication systems.

data.headline: Annotation
data.text: IMIS Online is a modern web-based distance learning programme which is supplemented by an introductory week and a summer camp on site in Soest. E-lectures, web-based training, interactive virtual collaborative learning concepts and consistent event coordination using the Moodle learning management system ensure that self-study is flexible and tailored to individual learning processes.
